nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Perform image-based product search on the 1688 platform. Use an image URL to find visually similar supplier products, returning title, price, minimum order quantity, monthly sales, repurchase rate, trade score, and seller identity. Triggered when users mention 1688 image search, 1688 visual search, find supplier by image, reverse image search 1688, 1688 product sourcing by image, or Alibaba 1688 image search. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "image search," this skill should be triggered whenever a user provides an image URL and wants to find matching or similar products on the 1688 wholesale platform.

filter.description: Comma-separated filter conditions. Use the supported filter values documented for this endpoint

imageBase64.description: Raw standard Base64 for PNG/JPEG; optional padding and outer whitespace allowed, embedded whitespace and data URI prefixes rejected for a sole direct source. Byte/header limits match imageUrl; at most 19,992,848 Base64 characters after outer whitespace trimming. Provide this as the only image source.

imageId.description: 1688 image ID. Image-search results also return this value; include it when page is greater than 1 to improve response time

imageUrl.description: Public HTTP/80 or HTTPS/443 URL, maximum 1,000 characters, without redirects. A sole direct source is checked for PNG/JPEG headers, at most 14.3 MiB, each dimension at most 20,000 and at most 40,000,000 pixels. This is not full pixel-integrity validation. Provide exactly one of imageUrl, imageBase64, or imageId.

keyword.description: Keyword used to search within the results

pageSize.description: Number of products per page; default 20, maximum 50

priceEnd.description: Maximum price in CNY, for example 100

priceStart.description: Minimum price in CNY, for example 10

productCollectionId.description: Single product-collection ID. Use a supported collection ID documented for this endpoint

sort.description: Sort condition as JSON in the form {field: direction}. Fields: price, rePurchaseRate, or monthSold. Directions: asc or desc

name: nexscope_1688_search_by_image
title: 1688 Search By Image
